svg.title: Contact and colophon
svg.desc: EMAIL: lawrence@reamus.app. DISCORD: btf_cookies. EIGHTBIT LABS: eightbitlabs.netlify.app. Generated from live GitHub data and refreshed daily. Six terminal panes, one palette: volume is still dot area and glow, category is colour now instead of pattern. Archivo Black and IBM Plex, baked to outlines; the avatar dithered to one bit and lit phosphor green.
